prospective_evaluation.selection: Existing exact-mapped games within frozen slate; only new observations after launch. Historical probe states are not imported. Includes already-started games prospectively.
prospective_evaluation.hypothesis: Reserving 40/200 book requests for new markets and interleaving games/families prevents old pending probes consuming all capacity.
prospective_evaluation.limits: Same one-contract probes, 5/15-minute horizons and validity guards. Independent laboratory, not a funded portfolio. No predictive parameter change.
prospective_evaluation.stopping: Pause new experiment for identity/accounting/transport failures; stop at existing September 18 deadline. Coverage remains sampling-limited.
